correctness.rationale: For a,b,u0>0 and unforced scalar u'= -a u-b u^2, R=b*u0/a. Reciprocal transformation solves u=u0 e^-at/(1+R(1-e^-at)). Monomial Carleman lift is upper bidiagonal y_j'=-ja y_j-jb y_(j+1). Order-N finite-section first component is u0 e^-at sum_{k=0}^{N-1}(-R(1-e^-at))^k, giving exact relative error z(t)^N. Finite-horizon uniform convergence iff z(T)<1; R>1 critical time tc=a^-1 log[R/(R-1)]. On infinite half line uniform absolute convergence iff R<=1; at R=1 optimizing x(1-x)^N/(2-x) yields x_N=(N+1-sqrt(N^2+1))/N and u0/(2eN) asymptotic. Under source scaling c/a=(1+R)/2, alternating vector Rayleigh quotient (N/2)[(c-a)N-(a+c)] positive for N>(R+3)/(R-1); the latter is a sufficient order, not minimal. Independent exact rational finite checks corroborate the closed forms.
